reason: The original Windows broadcast held 16 notifications and its ordinary stream silently discarded Lagged errors. A stopped recording receiver must not hide missing original payload. Sealed original receive also paid several seconds enumerating raw descriptors that the application never reads or writes.
changes: Windows callback queue holds 512 bounded notifications
Windows callback preserves monotonic receive time before queueing
checked_notifications exposes native lag to the recording durable-offset retry
Existing Peripheral notifications trait stays compatible and no device/subscription/connection is added
Windows sealed-receive extension discovers live services/characteristics without unused raw descriptors; normal discovery trait retains full behavior and WinRT CCCD subscriptions remain unchanged

Windows CCCD subscription/unsubscription, reads and writes with response request IAsyncOperation::Cancel when an in-flight caller is cancelled; normal completed status and errors are preserved. Bulk write-without-response remains unchanged.

R52: root service enumeration uses the existing native cancellation guard; root connect/discovery rejects non-Success instead of returning an old/empty service list. Native status/ATT protocol code is logged while existing PermissionDenied/NotConnected categories are retained.
limits: The ordinary trait keeps its upstream error semantics for existing callers. Recording uses the checked extension. Queue capacity is finite; overload is a receive failure, never successful consumption. Native Cancel is a request, not confirmation that an ATT procedure has retired. Existing unconfirmed release/connection retirement and exact consume gates remain in force. No MTU, PHY, payload size, retry budget or OS timeout change; physical cleanup/tail recovery remains unqualified.
validation: Companion .cache/stopped-upload-20261009/r17/native-queue-harness compiles the exact production util source with three burst/overflow/timestamp checks, avoiding unrelated upstream example dev dependencies. Product pull_receiver tests cover propagation, bounds, timing and cancellation. r61 cancellation tests implement the actual WinRT async interfaces: drop before/after first poll cancels once; completed/error/cancelled results are preserved. Vendor tests use its locked Windows0.61.1/windows-future0.2.0 resolution; the production Type lock uses Windows0.61.3/future0.2.1 and has not yet been built for r61.
license: LICENSE.md is copied unchanged; original package file hashes are retained in UPSTREAM.json.
